decks.notes: The core idea of this Temur Aggro deck is to use efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf alongside disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also utilizes Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble for extra card advantage and graveyard recursion. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to establish an aggressive board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Memnite or Inkmoth Nexus, for a fast and powerful attack. The deck focuses on utilizing equipment cards like Sword of Fire and Ice and Cranial Plating to enhance the equipped creature's abilities. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional tutor capabilities to search for key pieces of the combo, while Sigarda's Aid ensures that equipment can be equipped as soon as they are drawn.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively attack the opponent, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Grief, and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply early pressure. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and remove threats. Additionally, the deck has some graveyard interactions with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Undying Malice. The deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently while also disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. It also includes cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to provide control and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while using cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce for disruption and protection. The mana base is built to support the deck's three-color requirements and includes fetch lands to help thin the deck and find the necessary cards.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly infect the opponent's life total using creatures like Blighted Agent and Glistener Elf, combined with pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Might of Old Krosa. The deck also includes protection spells like Blossoming Defense and Vines of Vastwood to ensure the infect creatures survive. Additionally, the deck utilizes fetchlands like Wooded Foothills and Windswept Heath to thin out the deck and find the necessary lands. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with infect damage before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a defense.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to quickly summon powerful creatures onto the battlefield, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes a variety of control spells like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Wooded Foothills and Wrenn and Six for consistent mana fixing and card advantage. Overall, the strategy of the deck is to creatively assemble a powerful board presence while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The deck aims to control the board while building its own threats, utilizing cards like Unholy Heat and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo and advantage. With a mix of disruptive control elements and proactive aggression, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also includes a variety of spells and lands to support the combo, such as Lightning Bolt, Spell Pierce, and Wrenn and Six. Additionally, the deck includes Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board. The goal is to create a board state that overwhelms the opponent quickly and efficiently, using creative combos and spells to secure victory.

This deck aims to quickly mill the opponent's library by utilizing cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap. It disrupts the opponent's strategy with cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push, while also drawing cards with Visions of Beyond. Tasha's Hideous Laughter serves as a win condition by exiling cards from the opponent's library, while Jace, the Perfected Mind helps control the game and provide additional card advantage. The deck aims to mill the opponent out as quickly and efficiently as possible while disrupting their game plan.

The deck is focused on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana to play powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board and win the game through powerful threats and resource denial, while also having access to Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around dealing fast and efficient damage to the opponent using aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they can establish a defense or stabilize the board. The deck includes a mix of direct damage spells, efficient creatures with haste, and fetch lands to ensure a consistent mana base. synergistic cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel also punish the opponent for casting spells, further pressuring them to act quickly or risk taking additional damage.

This aggro deck utilizes a mix of creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The main strategy involves playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, supported by Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to finish off opponents. Stubborn Denial provides protection against opposing spells, while Leyline Binding helps control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra level of consistency to the deck. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, powerful creatures and direct damage spells.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to deal direct damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on and maintain a steady stream of damage to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear provide early threats, while burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike can finish off the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Boros Charm and Searing Blaze to provide versatility and control over the game.
